findings.title: DST gap/ambiguity not handled when attaching tzinfo to combined wall time
findings.recommendation: Validate the constructed datetime against the tz: detect non-existent times (skip/advance past the gap, e.g. re-check round-trip local==candidate.astimezone(tz).astimezone(tz)) and disambiguate fall-back times using fold, comparing candidate.astimezone(timezone.utc) against after before deciding to add a day. Add tests with a DST zone (e.g. America/New_York) at run_at around 02:30/01:30 on transition days.

findings.title: Silently strips tzinfo if run_at is timezone-aware
findings.evidence: wall = run_at.replace(tzinfo=None)  # run_at is a wall time in tz
findings.evidence_quote: wall = run_at.replace(tzinfo=None)  # run_at is a wall time in tz
findings.recommendation: Either reject a tz-aware run_at with a clear ValueError or document/assert that run_at must be a naive wall time, so an aware time passed by a caller is not silently reinterpreted in the wrong zone.
